description: This file defines the interface for HttpStream class, an abstraction for HTTP, SPDY, and QUIC streams, including method signatures for request registration, initialization, reading/writing data, connection management, and SSL info retrieval.

classes.name: net::HttpStream
classes.description: An abstract class representing an HTTP stream capable of handling HTTP, SPDY, and QUIC protocols, providing methods for request registration, stream initialization, data transfer, connection management, and SSL info.

methods.name: RegisterRequest
methods.description: Registers the HTTP request info for the stream, to be called before stream initialization.

methods.name: InitializeStream
methods.description: Initializes the stream with parameters like early send capability, priority, and logging, returning a net error code.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Sends HTTP request headers and body, filling response info, with callback for completion.

methods.name: ReadResponseHeaders
methods.description: Reads response headers from the socket, invoking callback when complete.

methods.name: ReadResponseBody
methods.description: Reads response body data into buffer, returning bytes read or error.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the stream, indicating if it is reusable.

methods.name: IsResponseBodyComplete
methods.description: Checks if the response body has been fully read.

methods.name: IsConnectionReused
methods.description: Indicates if the connection was reused.

methods.name: SetConnectionReused
methods.description: Marks the connection as reused.

methods.name: CanReuseConnection
methods.description: Checks if the connection can be reused.

methods.name: GetTotalReceivedBytes
methods.description: Returns total bytes received.

methods.name: GetTotalSentBytes
methods.description: Returns total bytes sent.

methods.name: GetLoadTimingInfo
methods.description: Populates load timing info for connection establishment.

methods.name: GetSSLInfo
methods.description: Retrieves SSL connection info.

methods.name: GetAlternativeService
methods.description: Retrieves alternative service info if used.

methods.name: GetSSLCertRequestInfo
methods.description: Retrieves SSL certificate request info.

methods.name: GetRemoteEndpoint
methods.description: Gets remote socket endpoint.

methods.name: Drain
methods.description: Drains the stream for error or redirect handling.

methods.name: PopulateNetErrorDetails
methods.description: Fills in network error details.

methods.name: SetPriority
methods.description: Updates request priority.

methods.name: RenewStreamForAuth
methods.description: Returns a new stream for authentication, invalidating the old one.

methods.name: SetRequestHeadersCallback
methods.description: Sets callback for request headers.

methods.name: SetRequestIdempotency
methods.description: Sets request idempotency status.

methods.name: GetDnsAliases
methods.description: Retrieves DNS aliases for the remote endpoint.

methods.name: GetAcceptChViaAlps
methods.description: Gets ACCEPT_CH value received during TLS handshake.

methods.name: GetQuicErrorCode
methods.description: Gets QUIC connection error code if applicable.

methods.name: GetQuicRstStreamErrorCode
methods.description: Gets QUIC stream error code if applicable.
